newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's 1997 inflation to reach 100 pct-finmin.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's 1997 inflation to reach 100 pct-finmin.

text.p: Turkey's economy minister Gunes Taner said on Tuesday he expected Turkey's inflation rate to be around 100 percent by the end of 1997.
"I expect inflation to be around 100 percent at the end of the year," Taner told Reuters in an interview.
Taner said the new government would embark on an ambitious privatisation programme in 1998, aiming to raise $12 billion in the first six months of the year.
"We are planning $12 billion worth of privatisation in the first six months of 1998," Taner said.

He said the government also planned to raise $4 billion this year through the selling of energy production and distribution utilities and mobile telephone licences as well as iron and steel producer Eregli.
Taner is economy minister in Turkey's new secularist government, approved earlier this month to replace an Islamist-led coalition forced out by pressure from Turkey's powerful military.
